claims_and_limits: October 27 announcement; trusted-tester research preview now, consumer and developer access forthcoming.
Google describes native audio, live natural-language changes, Gemini 3.8 Flash guiding the loop and Gemini Omni anchoring simulations.
The model page says a few minutes of continuous interaction and notes drift, physical/spatial and audio limitations.
The evaluation protocol in the article is our proposal, not a Google benchmark or established simulator accuracy.
